# Strix Halo Guide

Independent AMD Strix Halo / Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 local-AI setup and benchmark evidence.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/hogeheer499-commits/strix-halo-guide
Project website: https://strixhaloguide.com/
Technical web summary: https://hogeheer499-commits.github.io/strix-halo-guide/
Focused BIOS, UMA, IOMMU and local-LLM setup: https://hogeheer499-commits.github.io/strix-halo-guide/amd-strix-halo-setup/
Qwen3.8 27B route comparison: https://hogeheer499-commits.github.io/strix-halo-guide/qwen38-strix-halo/
Mini PC buying comparison (measured cross-OEM evidence, 64GB vs 128GB, price history): https://hogeheer499-commits.github.io/strix-halo-guide/best-strix-halo-mini-pc/
Troubleshooting (Ollama, Vulkan/RADV, ROCm, firmware, GTT, HIP correctness): https://hogeheer499-commits.github.io/strix-halo-guide/troubleshooting/
Model hub (measured here vs verified-but-unmeasured models and 128GB fit): https://hogeheer499-commits.github.io/strix-halo-guide/strix-halo-models/

## Trust and scope

Reproducibility rules: https://github.com/hogeheer499-commits/strix-halo-guide/blob/main/REPRODUCIBILITY.md
Accepted upstream work: https://github.com/hogeheer499-commits/strix-halo-guide/blob/main/UPSTREAM_CONTRIBUTIONS.md
Community results: https://github.com/hogeheer499-commits/strix-halo-guide/blob/main/COMMUNITY_RESULTS.md
Partner and disclosure brief: https://github.com/hogeheer499-commits/strix-halo-guide/blob/main/ONE_PAGE_BRIEF.md

Direct llama-bench, Ollama API, server, MTP/speculative, concurrency, capacity,
power, NPU, RPC, first-party, and community results are separate claim types.
A number without a linked CSV or raw artifact should be treated as unverified.
